description: Trace of every requirement in the 2026-11-14 brief to its current status. 'built' = implemented and published here; 'partial' = structure built with values blank/flagged per verification policy; 'exists' = delivered by a sibling hub (read-only reference); 'blocked' = cannot be completed without information that does not exist yet. Every row links a source.
readiness_matrix_note: Prepared 2026-11-15. Readiness labels and thresholds are this project’s proposals, not official NFL or industry standards. Observed values are drawn from the source dates shown per row; the underlying registers were not all refreshed on 2026-11-15. Unconfirmed subfields remain blank and are flagged.

rows.requirement: Price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
rows.status: partial - store contract built, 0 market prices captured
rows.what_exists: Schema + validator in price-store/ (parallel session); coverage register here: 45 market records (15 games x side/total/moneyline) with our open line captured on all 45, our close 0, market open 0, market close 0.
rows.gap: No official public price source exists (the NFL's official betting feed is distributed to operators by an exclusive distributor), and no second capture of our own line runs yet.
rows.blocking_gate: PRICE-G1 — no authorized market-price feed and no close captures; market/residual and CLV claims remain blocked.
rows.observed_value: 45 originated markets: our open 45/45; our close 0/45; market open 0/45; market close 0/45; complete open/close pairs 0/45.

observed_missing_fields.label: Authorized provider and permitted-use terms
observed_missing_fields.reason: Not established in the current register; see FL-LD-01.

rows.proposed_clear_threshold: Proposal: record permitted-use terms and source identity; capture a publisher/book, normalized market ID, price and UTC timestamp for both open and close on 100% of originated markets (45/45 for this slate), with 0 invalid or missing records. Otherwise keep market, residual and CLV cells blank.

rows.requirement: Verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
rows.what_exists: Per-row feed transcribed first-hand from NFL.com weekly schedule pages (weeks 7, 8, 9 and the week-10 Thursday game), each row with the official week page and game-centre link; cross-checked against the committed snapshot: 27/27 agree, 0 mismatches.
rows.gap: Weeks 1-6 (93 games per the committed snapshot) are pending capture; ROI still additionally needs prices (REQ-01).
rows.blocking_gate: RESULTS-G1 — official row-level capture for weeks 1–6 is missing. The 93-game pending denominator is from a third-party snapshot, not an official schedule count; price-based ROI also depends on REQ-01.
rows.observed_value: 44 official final rows; 27/27 committed-snapshot comparisons match and 0 mismatch; weeks 1–6 have no official row-level capture in this register.

observed_missing_fields.label: Official denominator for the pending weeks
observed_missing_fields.reason: The current 93-game count is third-party coverage metadata, not an official value; see FL-LD-03.

rows.proposed_clear_threshold: Proposal: for 100% of games in each declared played-week/season scope, store a unique game ID, official final score, verbatim official venue and direct NFL schedule/game link; link the official schedule-release announcement and publish weekly diffs. Timestamp every fetch and alarm when capture is >24 hours past the declared refresh window or source schema/hash changes without review (0 silent drift). Require 0 unresolved duplicates or score disagreements and an official schedule denominator. Keep price-based ROI blocked until REQ-01 clears.

rows.requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
rows.what_exists: compute.py originates and publishes in fixed order 1 side, 2 total, 3 moneyline; the moneyline is never produced before the side and total. All three fair lines published for the 15-game week-9 slate.
rows.gap: Order is enforced by this desk's pipeline only; the retired pipeline (results/originate.json) publishes different lines for the same games (FL-LD-07).
rows.blocking_gate: ORIGIN-G1 — the Line Desk order is fixed, but a second committed pipeline publishes different lines for the same 15 games (FL-LD-07).
rows.observed_value: Line Desk order is side → total → moneyline; its Week 9 register has 15 games, and the discrepancy register records 15 differing outputs from the retired pipeline.
rows.proposed_clear_threshold: Proposal: name exactly 1 canonical originator; automatically assert side → total → moneyline; require 0 unexplained differences across 100% of shared game IDs before release; publish each forecast as a probability/line with its inputs and version, and retire or reconcile superseded output.

rows.requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line, and the difference as separate columns
rows.status: partial - three separate columns built; market and difference blank
rows.what_exists: Side, total and moneyline tables each carry fair line | market line | difference as separate columns, plus settlement against the official result.
rows.gap: Market line and difference are blank on every row: no official price source (REQ-01). Third-party closes exist in the repo but are not published here under the verification policy.
rows.blocking_gate: PRICE-G1 — the market quote and residual columns exist but have no verified market prices; see REQ-01.
rows.observed_value: Fair / market / difference columns are separate for side, total and moneyline; verified market quotes captured 0/45 and residuals calculable from verified quotes 0/45, so those cells remain blank.
rows.proposed_clear_threshold: Proposal: on 100% of originated side, total, moneyline and player-prop rows, publish fair probability/line, timestamped market quote and a signed residual with a documented convention. Publish 2 separately defined and versioned total estimates with their inputs before applying any preregistered reconciliation rule; leave any field blank unless its source and time are captured.

rows.requirement: Separate 'signal' from 'staking' in the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
rows.status: built here - signal rank and staking rank computed separately
rows.what_exists: Signal rank uses only gates + outcome statistics (gates desc, BH-adjusted p, raw p, n); staking (ROI, CI) is reported in its own block and never enters the rank. Demonstration: the best staking rank (S7, +1.5% ROI) is signal rank 5 of 7; the best signal rank (S6) is staking rank 3.
rows.gap: The root leaderboard still ranks 'by gates passed, then by ROI' (flag PS-F3 raised by the price-store session); changing the root rule belongs to the root owner.
rows.blocking_gate: RANK-G1 — this desk separates signal from staking, but the root leaderboard still has an ROI tie-break and the signal score is not yet a proper-score-only rank.
rows.observed_value: 7 candidates; 0 qualify. This desk sorts its signal and staking blocks separately; the root leaderboard ROI tie-break remains flagged.
rows.proposed_clear_threshold: Proposal: use benchmark-relative out-of-sample proper-score skill as the signal sort key; require the game-clustered 95% lower confidence bound to exceed 0 after multiplicity correction; include 0 ROI, stake-size or raw-win-rate fields in the signal sort key; publish staking separately.

rows.requirement: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement
rows.status: partial - store and schema built; every depth cell blank
rows.what_exists: Replacement-depth store with per-row replacement_player / replacement_string (1st-4th) / depth_source fields; 11 official injury rows from a first-hand Week 10 read.
rows.gap: No official source states replacements or string tiers: the official report has no depth column (verified first-hand) and the league depth-chart path returns HTTP 404 (verified first-hand). All depth cells blank + flagged.
rows.blocking_gate: DEPTH-G1 — no official source in this register establishes replacement identity or string rank; the NFL depth-chart path returned 404 and the injury report has no depth column.
rows.observed_value: 11 sampled injury rows across 4 clubs; replacement-player and replacement-tier fields are verified for 0/11 rows.
rows.proposed_clear_threshold: Proposal: publish a replacement identity/tier only when a dated official source directly states it; require 100% source coverage for every nonblank depth claim and retain blanks with flags otherwise. Never use jersey order, inferred starters or injury designation as a depth/probability proxy.

rows.requirement: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value
rows.what_exists: Every coefficient computed only from NFL.com standings transcriptions (2026 n=32, 2025 n=32, pooled n=64); n and a 95% Fisher-z interval published with each value (NIST method).
rows.gap: Window limited to two seasons because standings are transcribed by hand; extending seasons is a capture task, not a method gap.
rows.blocking_gate: No blocker for the current two-season coefficient set; extension requires further official standings capture, and uncertainty remains wider than a longer verified window.
rows.observed_value: 8 official-input coefficients; season samples n=32 (2025), n=32 (2026), pooled n=64; each publishes n and a 95% interval.
rows.proposed_clear_threshold: Proposal: require 100% official input provenance, a published n and 95% interval for every coefficient, and exact reproduction from the registered rows before release; 0 unsourced coefficients.

rows.requirement: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
rows.what_exists: Promotion checks P1-P3 and demotion gates D1-CLV (price-store, CLV side), D2-outcome (this desk: n>=200 and one-sided 95% ROI upper bound < 0), D3-integrity (HOLD, never demote on missing data). Dry run on the 7 committed candidates: 0 promoted, 0 demoted, all stay PAPER.
rows.gap: No strategy is live (0 of 7 pass promotion), and D1 has no price input, so the gate is defined and tested but has no live subject. Thresholds are proposals, not an official standard.
rows.blocking_gate: DEMOTE-G1 — D1 CLV has no price input; no strategy is LIVE, so the state machine has no live subject. Missing input must HOLD, not trigger a synthetic result.
rows.observed_value: 0/7 promoted; 0/7 demoted; 7/7 remain PAPER; 0 market-price captures and no live strategy.
rows.proposed_clear_threshold: Proposal: require all 10 registered validation gates, a verified licensed source and 100% eligible price-snapshot coverage before promotion. For D1/D2, evaluate only after n≥200 settled observations and demote only when the one-sided 95% upper bound is below 0; missing inputs always HOLD.

rows.requirement: Research and develop strategies for useful signals; singles, parlays, player prop combos; validation gates; remove luck; skill-based selection
rows.what_exists: Root Line Lab + quant-lab, origination-lab, skill-lab, lineup-lab, pipeline/origination hubs publish 7-31 strategies each, 10-gate validation, FDR/luck controls. 0 strategies qualify anywhere; rewards are unpaid design.
rows.gap: Consolidation of gate names and reward schedules across hubs remains open (verify-hub RB reconciliation); no strategy has cleared any gate set.
rows.blocking_gate: STRATEGY-G1 — 0/7 candidates qualify; cross-hub gate/reward names remain unreconciled, and this desk has no completed joint-probability plus push/void validation record for combination families.
rows.observed_value: 0/7 Line Desk candidates qualify under the committed gate register; no combination-family validation is recorded in this desk.
rows.proposed_clear_threshold: Proposal: preregister every candidate before evaluation and keep 4 divisions separate (singles, parlays, same-game parlays, prop combos). Admit a combo only after held-out joint-probability calibration and applicable push/void settlement tests. Require 10/10 harmonized gates and benchmark-relative proper-score skill with game-clustered 95% lower bound >0 after multiplicity correction, random/favorites controls and chronological luck/ablation checks; publish a removal-of-luck dashboard for every candidate, and never rank by ROI or raw win rate.

rows.gap: Reward pool is not funded and jurisdiction/eligibility terms are undecided (carried flag from sibling hubs).
rows.blocking_gate: REWARD-G1 — no verified funded balance or jurisdiction/eligibility terms; no candidate qualifies for a reward.

rows.requirement: System tracks injuries and defensive/offensive deficiencies (2nd/3rd/4th-string replacements)
rows.status: partial - official injury facts tracked; deficiency unmeasurable
rows.what_exists: Official Week 10 injury rows (status/practice) first-hand; sibling hubs carry fuller weekly captures (decision-desk 254 rows, review-board 213 rows - their scopes).
rows.gap: Deficiency = f(injury, depth of replacement). Depth is blank everywhere (REQ-06), so the deficiency signal stays uncomputed rather than proxied.
rows.blocking_gate: INJURY-DEPTH-G1 — the Line Desk sample is limited to 4/32 clubs and has no verified replacement tiers; full expected-vs-actual availability and Game Book snap evidence are not integrated here.
rows.observed_value: 11 injury rows sampled across 4/32 clubs; replacement players and tiers confirmed for 0/11 rows.
rows.proposed_clear_threshold: Proposal: cover 32/32 teams for every in-scope week with immutable timestamped expected availability and separately sourced actual active/inactive status; link dated official roster/IR records and official Game Book snaps/playing time; source every nonblank replacement claim; run chronological injury/depth ablations. Do not infer starters, apply fixed injury penalties, or convert designation levels to probabilities; blank and flag any missing evidence.
